source_review.method: All native7 local source bodies manually read before final extraction. JS TS AST, static HTML quoted attributes/text and CSS quoted strings partitioned individually. Embedded generated-HTML prose extracted as exact source fragments with parent lexical anchor/line/column/offset; remaining structural parent records crosslink fixed fragments. No executing bundle, DOM, browser or native export.

limits: Independently reviewable native7 complete local bodies only; vendor3 whole-body text/diagnostic consumers explicitly pending despite exact archive/census proof.
Nine declaration/source-map entries are nonruntime metadata, not vendor exclusions or a claim of duplicate sourcesContent inventory.
Source-only audit; no browser/DOM/native export/model/child/network execution or runtime/platform proof.
Current AgentState prompt and tools are used only by live export; exportFromFile supplies neither header field. All-entry data remains independent from viewer selected branch.
Fixed generated templates preserve raw source interpolation expressions/escapes; TS string literals are decoded. Structural tags/classes/handler expressions and dynamic payload are protected.
Compaction/branch-summary prompt generators, arbitrary extension tool/metadata renderers, provider/OS/browser/parser diagnostic producers and remaining package graph stay open.
